decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. The proposed first floor side extension and single storey rear extension by reason of their excessive size, bulk, design and position would constitute an obtrusive feature infilling this side area and be out of character with this property and those adjoining and would could harm the appearance of the area generally.  It would therefore be contrary to policies ENV B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Adopted UDP and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2. The proposed first floor side extension and single storey rear extension by reason of their excessive size, bulk, design and position would represent an obtrusive feature which would harm the living conditions of the adjoining properties by reason of sense of enclosure, loss of outlook, overshadowing and loss of light, contrary to policies ENV B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Adopted UDP and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 3 - 3.The proposed off-street parking provision fails to meet the Council's Parking Standards and would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to policy T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Adopted UDP and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.
